liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Train 45** (1 review): The reviewer enjoys the train songs on this show, which they rank among their favorite recordings [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Banjo Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **Shenandoah Breakdown**: rare: 6 archived performances [7]
- **Fiddling Around**: rare: 14 archived performances [7]
- **Freight Train Boogie**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **Make Me a Pallet on Your Floor**: back after 113 archived shows (471 days); rare: 5 archived performances [7]
- **Look Up Look Down That Lonesome Road**: rare: 9 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-11-13.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 26 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **billystrings2022-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 149 min [2]
- **billystrings2022-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 147 min [3]
- **billystrings2022-11-13.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 26 songs; 150 min [4]

## Around the show

- Andy Lytle was the front-of-house sound engineer for the show [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-11-13.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY250/5i>Schoeps VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-3 II [1]. Also: Captured with Schoeps MK41v microphones through Schoeps preamp stages into a Sound Devices MixPre-3 II at 32-bit float, 96kHz; Mixed in Nuendo 4.3, then Sound Forge Pro 16 for fades and downconversion to 16-bit/44.1kHz, then FLAC via Trader's Little Helper and tagged in Foobar2000 [1]
- **billystrings2022-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac24**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: AKG CK61/c460b > TASCAM-DR-100MK3 (24/48kHz) [2]. Also: Transfer from SD card through Audacity (slight amplification, normalizing), then CD Wave and Foobar2000 tagging; this is the 24-bit release [2]
- **billystrings2022-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac16**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: AKG CK61/c460b > TASCAM-DR-100MK3 (24/48kHz) [3]. Also: Rich Stoler's AKG CK61/c460b recording on a TASCAM DR-100MK3 was dithered to 16-bit in Audacity for this release [3]
- **billystrings2022-11-13.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY250/5i>Schoeps VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-3 II [4]
